SUPREME COURT OF THE UNITED STATES
                                     _________________

                                     No. 06–5618
                                     _________________


MARIO CLAIBORNE, PETITIONER v. UNITED STATES
 ON WRIT OF CERTIORARI TO THE UNITED STATES COURT OF 

           APPEALS FOR THE EIGHTH CIRCUIT

                                   [June 4, 2007]


  PER CURIAM.
  The Court is advised that the petitioner died in
St. Louis, Missouri, on May 30, 2007. The judgment of the
United States Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit is
therefore vacated as moot. See United States v. Munsing
wear, Inc., 340 U. S. 36 (1950).
                                           It is so ordered.
